command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$paths=@('AGG_SW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core','SZ_Server_Cluster1','HQ_MKT_AP01','EMPLOYEE_WIFI_CLIENT01'); foreach(`$id in `$paths){`$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_04/nodes/'+`$id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o1=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output; `$o2=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output; if(`$o1 -like 'Error:*' -or `$o2 -like 'Error:*'){Write-Output (`$id+': unavailable c='+`$o1.Length+' b='+`$o2.Length)} else {`$a=`$o1 -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$b=`$o2 -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$d=Compare-Object `$b `$a; Write-Output (`$id+': diff='+@(`$d).Count); if(@(`$d).Count -le 20){`$d | ForEach-Object {Write-Output ('  '+`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject)}}}}"
